title: 預力混凝土孔道灌漿~Prestressing-duct grouting
focus: 以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕~Grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades
summary: 從 1985 年威爾斯 Ynys-y-Gwas 橋的突然崩塌與英國 1992 年暫停新建灌漿後拉橋的決定出發，說明灌漿如何同時提供防蝕與握裹，量化鋼腱斷絲的預力損失、高點泌水、氯離子含量與孔道面積比，再處理灌漿壓力與流速、錨頭封護與真空補灌、流度泌水與密度試驗、空洞非破壞檢測、硫酸鹽與氯離子劣化以及灌漿紀錄與風險分級，並以 2000 年夏洛特賽車場人行橋與倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋為鑑。~Starting from the sudden 1985 collapse of the Ynys-y-Gwas bridge in Wales and Britain's 1992 halt on new grouted post-tensioned bridges, explain how grout provides both corrosion protection and bond, quantify force loss from broken strands, bleed at high points, chloride content and duct area ratio, then cover grouting pressure and rate, anchorage protection and vacuum regrouting, fluidity, bleed and density testing, non-destructive void detection, sulfate and chloride deterioration and grouting records and risk ranking, learning from the 2000 Charlotte Motor Speedway footbridge and London's Hammersmith Flyover.

units.anchor: 鋼腱有效預力 P_e~Tendon effective force P_e
units.title: 灌漿的功能與鋼腱腐蝕後果~What grout does and the consequences of tendon corrosion
units.mechanism: 後拉預力鋼腱在張拉錨定後，孔道內必須以水泥系灌漿完全填滿：灌漿的高鹼性使鋼絞線表面鈍化而不鏽蝕，硬化後又把鋼腱與周圍混凝土握裹在一起，使預力不再只依賴兩端錨頭，局部斷絲時力量也能在短距離內重新傳回混凝土。一旦孔道留下空洞、泌水或灌漿受氯離子汙染，鋼絞線在看不見的地方腐蝕，強度高、斷面小的鋼絲對蝕坑特別敏感，可能在沒有明顯預兆下斷裂。威爾斯 1953 年建成的 Ynys-y-Gwas 單跨預鑄節塊後拉橋，就因節塊間現澆接縫處保護不足的鋼腱腐蝕，在 1985 年突然崩塌。~After a post-tensioning tendon is stressed and anchored, its duct must be completely filled with cementitious grout: the grout's high alkalinity passivates the strand surface against rusting, and once hardened it bonds tendon to concrete so the prestress no longer depends only on the end anchorages and a local wire break can re-transfer force to the concrete within a short length. Voids, bleed water or chloride-contaminated grout let strands corrode out of sight, and high-strength wires with small sections are especially sensitive to pits, so they can fracture without obvious warning. The single-span precast segmental Ynys-y-Gwas bridge in Wales, built in 1953, collapsed suddenly in 1985 because tendons corroded at the in-situ joints between segments, where they were inadequately protected.
units.model: 19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線，每股 140 mm²，A_ps = 2,660 mm²；有效應力 1,100 MPa 時 P_e = 2,660×1,100 ≈ 2.93 MN。若腐蝕使 3 股斷裂，預力損失 3/19 ≈ 16%，約 0.46 MN；斷絲集中在同一斷面時，該處彎曲強度與裂縫控制同步下降。數值為教學假設。~A 19-strand tendon of 15.2 mm strand at 140 mm² each has A_ps = 2,660 mm²; at an effective stress of 1,100 MPa, P_e = 2,660×1,100 ≈ 2.93 MN. If corrosion breaks 3 strands, the force loss is 3/19 ≈ 16%, about 0.46 MN; with breaks concentrated at one section, flexural strength and crack control fall together there. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以設計圖整理每條鋼腱的股數、有效預力、線形與錨頭位置，標示節塊接縫、耦合器與高點等易腐蝕位置；檢查計畫優先抽查這些位置，並以結構分析評估單一鋼腱失去部分或全部預力時的剩餘承載。~From the design drawings tabulate each tendon's strand count, effective force, profile and anchorage locations, marking corrosion-prone points such as segment joints, couplers and high points; prioritise them in inspection and assess by structural analysis the remaining capacity if one tendon loses part or all of its force.
units.failure: Ynys-y-Gwas 橋崩塌前外觀沒有明顯警訊；鋼腱在接縫處腐蝕斷裂，結構在沒有超載的情況下突然倒塌。這類破壞的特徵正是灌漿缺陷與鋼腱腐蝕都藏在混凝土內，日常目視檢查難以發現。~The Ynys-y-Gwas bridge showed no obvious warning before it fell; tendons corroded through at the joints and the structure collapsed suddenly without overload. The hallmark of such failures is that both grout defects and tendon corrosion are hidden inside the concrete, beyond routine visual inspection.
units.misconception: 鋼腱被包在混凝土裡面，自然就不會生鏽。~Tendons buried inside concrete cannot rust.
units.practice: 設計階段就把節塊接縫、耦合器與錨頭列為防蝕重點，採用多層保護（密封塑膠孔道、完整灌漿、錨頭封蓋與防水），並在圖面上標示每條鋼腱的灌漿與排氣口位置。~At design make segment joints, couplers and anchorages corrosion-protection priorities with multilayer protection (sealed plastic ducts, complete grouting, anchorage caps and waterproofing), and show every tendon's grout inlets and vents on the drawings.

units.anchor: 高點泌水層~Bleed-water lens at high points
units.title: 鋼腱線形、高點與空洞形成~Tendon profile, high points and void formation
units.mechanism: 連續梁的鋼腱線形在墩頂向上彎、在跨中向下彎，灌漿沿孔道流動時，空氣與泌水會往高點聚集；鋼絞線束在孔道內形成細小通道，會像燈芯一樣把水往上吸，使高點與錨頭附近更容易留下水層與空洞。水分之後被吸收或蒸發，留下的就是空洞，而鋼絞線正好暴露在潮濕空氣中。FHWA 的研究指出，美國在 1999 年起陸續發現的鋼腱耐久問題，多與灌漿空洞、泌水以及錨頭與高點處的鋼絞線腐蝕有關。~A continuous girder's tendon rises over the piers and dips at midspan; as grout flows along the duct, air and bleed water collect at high points, and the strand bundle forms fine channels that wick water upward like a lamp wick, so water lenses and voids are more likely at crests and near anchorages. The water is later absorbed or evaporates, leaving a void with strands exposed to damp air. FHWA research notes that the tendon durability problems found in the United States from 1999 onward were associated with grout voids, bleed water and strand corrosion at anchorages and crests.
units.model: 高點泌水層厚度 ≈ 泌水率 × 灌漿柱高。墩頂高點比相鄰低點高 2.0 m，灌漿泌水率 2% 時水層約 0.02×2,000 = 40 mm，足以淹沒孔道頂部的鋼絞線；泌水率 0% 的觸變性灌漿理論上不形成水層。數值為教學假設。~High-point bleed lens thickness ≈ bleed fraction × grout column height. With a crest 2.0 m above the adjacent low point and 2% bleed, the lens is about 0.02×2,000 = 40 mm, enough to cover strands at the top of the duct; a thixotropic grout with 0% bleed theoretically forms no lens. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依鋼腱線形圖逐條標出高點、低點與錨頭，確認每個高點都有排氣管、低點有灌漿口或排水口；以灌漿試驗中的泌水結果檢查材料在實際高差下是否會形成水層，必要時以實尺寸模擬孔道試灌。~Mark high points, low points and anchorages on each tendon profile, confirming every crest has a vent and every low point an inlet or drain; check bleed results from grout tests against the actual height differences, and if needed trial-grout a full-scale mock-up duct.
units.failure: 只在兩端錨頭設灌漿口與出漿口而高點沒有排氣管，空氣被困在墩頂高點；或使用泌水率高的配比，泌水沿鋼絞線集中到高點與錨頭，數年後這些位置的鋼絞線先腐蝕。~Providing grout ports only at the two anchorages with no vent at the crest traps air over the pier; a high-bleed mix lets water migrate along the strands to crests and anchorages, where strands corrode first within a few years.
units.misconception: 灌漿從一端打入、另一端出漿，就代表孔道已經完全填滿。~If grout pumped in at one end comes out at the other, the duct is completely filled.
units.practice: 孔道配置圖要列出每個高點、低點與錨頭的排氣或灌漿口，並規定高點排氣管延伸到高於孔道的位置以便觀察；施工前由設計者與專業承包商共同確認配置。~The duct layout drawing lists the vent or inlet at every crest, low point and anchorage and requires crest vents to rise above the duct for observation; the designer and the specialist contractor confirm the layout together before construction.

units.anchor: 灌漿等級與氯離子上限~Grout class and chloride limit
units.title: 灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制~Grout materials, mix design and chloride control
units.mechanism: 現代後拉灌漿多採工廠預拌包裝的材料，美國 PTI M55.1 把灌漿分為 A 至 D 四級（A 非侵蝕環境、B 侵蝕環境、C 預拌產品適用兩者、D 由工程師決定），規定水泥種類、礦物摻料與最大水膠比 0.45，並禁止使用緻密化矽灰。灌漿中的氯離子與硫酸鹽會破壞鋼材鈍化膜，美國 PTI、ACI 與 AASHTO 以水泥重量 0.08% 作為酸溶性氯離子上限，歐洲標準則為 0.10%。2001 年後預拌觸變性灌漿普及，但 FHWA 調查顯示部分新橋仍因材料離析、軟化與高氯、高硫酸鹽而腐蝕，說明材料管理與現場拌合同樣重要。~Modern post-tensioning grouts are mostly factory pre-bagged; PTI M55.1 in the United States defines classes A to D (A for non-aggressive, B for aggressive, C pre-bagged for either, D as specified by the engineer), sets cement types, supplementary materials and a maximum water-to-cementitious ratio of 0.45, and prohibits densified silica fume. Chlorides and sulfates in grout break down the steel's passive film, and PTI, ACI and AASHTO limit acid-soluble chloride to 0.08% by weight of cement, while the European standard uses 0.10%. Pre-bagged thixotropic grouts spread after 2001, yet FHWA investigations found some newer bridges still corroding because of segregated, soft grout with high chloride and sulfate, showing that material control matters as much as field mixing.
units.model: 拌合水帶入的氯離子 = 水灰比 × 水中氯離子濃度。w/c = 0.40、拌合水含 500 mg/L：每 kg 水泥帶入 0.40×500 = 200 mg，即 0.02%，加上材料本身 0.05% 共 0.07%，低於 0.08%；若誤用海水（約 19,000 mg/L），單由水帶入 0.76%，遠超上限。數值為教學假設。~Chloride from mixing water = water–cement ratio × chloride concentration. With w/c = 0.40 and 500 mg/L in the water, each kg of cement receives 0.40×500 = 200 mg, i.e. 0.02%, which with 0.05% from the material totals 0.07%, below 0.08%; seawater at about 19,000 mg/L would contribute 0.76% from the water alone, far above the limit. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 審查灌漿產品的型式試驗報告（流度、泌水、凝結時間、強度、氯離子與硫酸鹽含量）與批號；現場確認包裝未受潮、未過期、儲存條件合格，拌合水來源經水質檢驗，並保留每批材料的出廠證明。~Review the grout product's qualification reports (fluidity, bleed, setting time, strength, chloride and sulfate content) and batch numbers; on site confirm bags are dry, in date and properly stored, that mixing water is tested and that mill certificates are kept for every lot.
units.failure: 2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷；材料的一個未授權變更就足以摧毀整套防蝕系統。~In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands; a single unapproved change to the material can defeat the whole corrosion-protection system.
units.misconception: 加一點早強劑或其他添加劑讓灌漿更快硬化，對鋼腱沒有影響。~Adding a little accelerator or another admixture to speed grout hardening does not affect the tendons.
units.practice: 規格書明定灌漿等級、核可產品與禁止事項（禁止現場添加任何未經核准的外加劑、禁止使用含氯材料），任何材料替換都須重新提交試驗並經設計者書面核准。~The specification fixes grout class, approved products and prohibitions (no unapproved admixtures added on site, no chloride-bearing materials), and any substitution requires a new test submittal and the designer's written approval.

units.anchor: 孔道面積比與灌漿量~Duct area ratio and grout volume
units.title: 孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部~Ducts, ports and anchorage details
units.mechanism: 孔道必須夠大，讓鋼絞線穿索後仍留有足夠空間讓灌漿流過並包覆每一股；密封的塑膠波紋管比鍍鋅鋼管更能阻絕外部水分與氯離子，但接頭、耦合器與節塊接縫處必須確實密封。灌漿口與排氣管的內徑也有下限，FHWA 手冊建議鋼絞線鋼腱的進出口內徑至少 20 mm，以免灌漿阻塞。錨頭是最容易進水的位置，需以永久封蓋灌滿，再以混凝土封頭與防水層保護。~Ducts must be large enough to leave space for grout to flow around every strand after threading; sealed corrugated plastic ducts block external water and chlorides better than galvanised steel, but joints, couplers and segment interfaces must be properly sealed. Inlets and vents also have minimum sizes; the FHWA manual recommends at least 20 mm internal diameter for strand-tendon ports so grout does not block them. Anchorages are the easiest entry point for water and need permanent caps filled with grout, then concrete pour-backs and waterproofing.
units.model: 孔道內徑 100 mm，面積 π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm²，鋼絞線 2,660 mm²，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95；每公尺灌漿淨面積 7,854 − 2,660 ≈ 5,194 mm²，100 m 鋼腱理論灌漿量約 0.52 m³。若改用 90 mm 孔道，面積比降為約 2.39。數值為教學假設，面積比下限依規範。~A 100 mm duct has π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm² against 2,660 mm² of strand, an area ratio of about 2.95; the net grout area is about 5,194 mm² per metre, so a 100 m tendon needs about 0.52 m³ of grout in theory. A 90 mm duct lowers the ratio to about 2.39. Values are teaching assumptions; the minimum ratio follows the code.
units.verify: 檢查孔道材料證明、壁厚、接頭與耦合器的密封方式，澆置混凝土前以壓力或真空試驗確認孔道系統氣密；量測灌漿口與排氣管內徑與位置，並在混凝土澆置後以通球或吹氣確認孔道未被壓扁或堵塞。~Check duct material certificates, wall thickness and sealing of joints and couplers, and pressure- or vacuum-test the duct system for airtightness before concreting; measure port diameters and locations, and after concreting confirm by pulling a ball or blowing air that ducts are neither crushed nor blocked.
units.failure: 節塊接縫處孔道未以密封環對接，混凝土漿與後來的雨水從接縫進入孔道；混凝土澆置時振動棒壓扁孔道，灌漿無法通過而在一側留下長段空洞。~Ducts not joined with sealing couplers at segment joints let cement paste and later rainwater enter the duct; a vibrator crushing the duct during concreting stops grout passing and leaves a long void on one side.
units.misconception: 孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。~A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter.
units.practice: 把孔道氣密試驗與通孔確認列為澆置混凝土與灌漿前的兩個停留點；錨頭封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水細部在施工圖中逐一繪出，不得留待現場決定。~Make duct airtightness testing and clear-passage confirmation hold points before concreting and before grouting; draw anchorage caps, pour-backs and waterproofing details individually on the shop drawings rather than leaving them to site decisions.

units.anchor: 灌漿推進速度與壓力~Grout advance rate and pressure
units.title: 灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序~Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence
units.mechanism: 灌漿要從最低點的灌漿口以連續、穩定的流量推進，讓灌漿前緣把空氣與水推向排氣口；每個排氣口在流出與進料一致、無氣泡的灌漿後才依序關閉，直到最後出漿口確認後再加壓保持一段時間。推進太快會讓灌漿越過鋼絞線間的空氣而形成空洞，太慢或中斷則讓灌漿在孔道內開始凝結。壓力要控制在孔道與錨頭可承受範圍內，垂直或高差大的鋼腱還要考慮靜水壓與雙閥門。~Grout is pumped from the lowest inlet at a continuous, steady rate so the grout front pushes air and water toward the vents; each vent is closed in sequence only once grout of the same consistency as the feed, free of bubbles, flows from it, and after the final outlet is confirmed the system is held under pressure for a period. Advancing too fast lets grout bypass air between strands and leave voids; too slow, or interrupted, lets grout begin to set inside the duct. Pressure must stay within what ducts and anchorages can take, and vertical or steep tendons must also consider static head and double valves.
units.model: 幫浦流量 30 L/min，孔道淨面積 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m，推進速度 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min；100 m 鋼腱 0.52 m³ 約需 17 分鐘連續灌注。若高點比灌漿口高 3 m、灌漿密度 1,900 kg/m³，靜水壓 1,900×9.81×3 ≈ 56 kPa，須加在摩擦損失之上。數值為教學假設。~At a pump rate of 30 L/min and a net duct area of 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m, the grout advances at 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min, so a 100 m tendon of 0.52 m³ needs about 17 minutes of continuous pumping. With a crest 3 m above the inlet and grout density 1,900 kg/m³, static head is 1,900×9.81×3 ≈ 56 kPa, added to friction losses. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 灌漿前確認幫浦、備用幫浦與足夠材料就位，逐條鋼腱記錄開始與結束時間、壓力歷程、各排氣口關閉時間與出漿狀態；在出漿口取樣量測流度與密度，與進料比較，確認出口灌漿未被稀釋或混入空氣。~Before grouting confirm the pump, a standby pump and sufficient material are ready; for each tendon record start and finish times, pressure history, vent closing times and outflow condition; sample at the outlet for fluidity and density and compare with the feed to confirm the outflow is neither diluted nor aerated.
units.failure: 灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道；或排氣口一見到灌漿就關閉，前緣夾帶的水與空氣被封在孔道內。~A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty; closing vents as soon as any grout appears traps the water and air carried at the front inside the duct.
units.misconception: 灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。~The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely.
units.practice: 灌漿作業由取得專業認證的人員執行並由監造全程見證，每條鋼腱的灌漿紀錄當場簽認；中斷時依事先核准的應變程序（例如立即以水沖洗或改由另一灌漿口完成）處理，不得臨場自行判斷。~Grouting is carried out by certified specialists and witnessed throughout by the inspector, with each tendon's record signed on the spot; interruptions follow a pre-approved contingency (for example immediate flushing or completion from another inlet), never improvisation.

units.anchor: 真空補灌與空洞體積~Vacuum regrouting and void volume
units.title: 錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查~Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks
units.mechanism: 灌漿完成並初凝後，要檢查高點與錨頭是否因沉降或泌水被吸收而出現空洞：常見做法是在高點排氣管與錨頭封蓋處開孔，以探針或內視鏡觀察，必要時以真空輔助補灌。真空補灌先把空洞抽成低壓，再讓灌漿被吸入，能填入細小且彎曲的空間；以已知容積的儲氣槽連接空洞並觀察壓力平衡，即可依波以耳定律估算空洞體積，進而確認補灌量。錨頭最後以永久封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水塗層多層保護。~After grouting and initial set, high points and anchorages are checked for voids caused by settlement or bleed reabsorption: vents at crests and anchorage caps are opened and probed or viewed with a borescope, and vacuum-assisted regrouting is used where needed. Vacuum regrouting first evacuates the void, then lets grout be drawn in, filling small and tortuous spaces; connecting a reservoir of known volume to the void and observing the pressure equalisation estimates the void volume by Boyle's law, confirming the regrout quantity. The anchorage is finally protected in layers by a permanent cap, a concrete pour-back and a waterproof coating.
units.model: 波以耳定律 p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v)。儲氣槽 V_r = 20 L、1.0 bar，空洞抽到 0.1 bar，連通後平衡為 0.8 bar：20×1.0 + 0.1V_v = 0.8×(20 + V_v)，得 V_v = 4/0.7 ≈ 5.7 L，即約 1.1 m 長孔道的淨灌漿體積。數值為教學假設。~Boyle's law p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v). With a 20 L reservoir at 1.0 bar, a void evacuated to 0.1 bar and equalisation at 0.8 bar: 20×1.0 + 0.1V_v = 0.8×(20 + V_v), so V_v = 4/0.7 ≈ 5.7 L, the net grout volume of about 1.1 m of duct. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依計畫在每條鋼腱的高點與錨頭抽查空洞，以探針或量規量測空洞深度並記錄位置；補灌後重新檢查，確認補灌量與估算空洞體積一致；錨頭封蓋灌滿後以敲擊或開孔抽查，封頭混凝土與防水層依圖施作並拍照存證。~Check for voids at each tendon's crests and anchorages as planned, measuring depth with a probe or gauge and recording location; after regrouting recheck and confirm that the regrout quantity matches the estimated void volume; after caps are filled check by sounding or test holes, and build pour-backs and waterproofing as drawn with photographic records.
units.failure: 完工後沒有檢查高點與錨頭，泌水被吸收後留下的空洞與封蓋內未填滿的空間長期存在；錨頭封頭混凝土開裂後，雨水與除冰鹽直接進入錨頭與鋼絞線端部，是許多鋼腱腐蝕案例的起點。~Without checks at crests and anchorages after completion, voids left by reabsorbed bleed water and unfilled cap space persist for years; once the anchorage pour-back cracks, rain and de-icing salt enter the anchorage and strand ends directly, the starting point of many tendon corrosion cases.
units.misconception: 灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。~If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages.
units.practice: 把「初凝後高點與錨頭空洞檢查」與「錨頭封護完成」列為獨立的停留點，檢查孔洞事後以相容材料封閉；補灌由合格人員依核准程序進行，結果寫入該鋼腱的灌漿紀錄。~Make the post-set void check at crests and anchorages and completion of anchorage protection separate hold points, sealing inspection holes afterwards with compatible material; regrouting is done by qualified personnel to an approved procedure and recorded in that tendon's grouting record.

units.anchor: 流錐、泌水與密度試驗~Flow-cone, bleed and density tests
units.title: 灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌~Grout testing and field mock-ups
units.mechanism: 灌漿品質要以試驗證明：流錐試驗（ASTM C939 標準或改良式）量測一定體積灌漿流出的時間，反映流動性；燈芯泌水試驗把鋼絞線插入灌漿柱，模擬鋼絞線吸水造成的泌水；加壓泌水試驗以過濾漏斗在壓力下量測水分分離，反映高差大的鋼腱中灌漿是否會被擠出水分；傾斜管試驗則以實尺寸傾斜孔道檢查高點空洞。現場還可用泥漿密度計快速檢查是否多加了水。重要工程先做實尺寸試灌，剖開確認填充品質。~Grout quality must be proven by testing: the flow-cone test (ASTM C939 standard or modified) times the efflux of a fixed volume to reflect fluidity; the wick-induced bleed test inserts strand into a grout column to mimic water drawn along strands; the bleed-under-pressure test uses a filtration funnel to measure water separation under pressure, reflecting whether grout in tall tendons will be squeezed dry; and the inclined-tube test checks high-point voids in a full-size inclined duct. On site a mud balance quickly checks whether extra water was added. Important projects first grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open to confirm filling.
units.model: 理論密度 ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c)。水泥比重 3.15、w/c = 0.40：ρ = 1.40/(0.3175 + 0.40) ≈ 1.95 kg/L；若現場多加水使 w/c = 0.45，ρ = 1.45/0.7675 ≈ 1.89 kg/L，低約 62 kg/m³。燈芯泌水試驗 800 mL 試樣分離 2 mL 水，泌水率 0.25%，對要求 0% 的觸變性灌漿判定不合格。數值為教學假設。~Theoretical density ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c). With cement specific gravity 3.15 and w/c = 0.40, ρ = 1.40/(0.3175 + 0.40) ≈ 1.95 kg/L; extra water raising w/c to 0.45 gives ρ = 1.45/0.7675 ≈ 1.89 kg/L, about 62 kg/m³ lower. A wick-bleed sample of 800 mL separating 2 mL of water shows 0.25% bleed and fails a thixotropic grout required to show 0%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 送審階段以實驗室試驗確認材料符合規格；開工前做實尺寸試灌並剖開檢查；施工中每批拌合量測流錐時間與密度，並依規定頻率做泌水與抗壓試驗，結果與允收值比較，不合格批次立即廢棄。~At submittal confirm by laboratory tests that the material meets the specification; before production grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open; during production measure flow-cone time and density for every batch and run bleed and compressive tests at the specified frequency, comparing with acceptance values and discarding failing batches immediately.
units.failure: 現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。~Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids; testing only on the first day lets later batch changes or short mixing times go unnoticed.
units.misconception: 灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。~The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality.
units.practice: 品質計畫列出每項試驗的標準、頻率、允收值與退料規則，拌合加水量以計量設備控制並記錄；實尺寸試灌與剖開檢查列為正式灌漿前的停留點，由設計者或其代表見證。~The quality plan lists standard, frequency, acceptance value and rejection rule for each test, with mixing water metered and recorded; the full-size mock-up and its sectioning are a hold point before production grouting, witnessed by the designer or a representative.

units.title: 空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測~Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection
units.mechanism: 完工後或既有橋梁的灌漿狀態只能間接判斷：透地雷達先定位內部鋼腱，敲擊回音法以應力波在混凝土中反射的頻率判斷孔道處是否有空洞，超音波斷層掃描可建立斷面影像，放射線攝影則能直接看見孔道內部但受安全與厚度限制。非破壞結果有疑問時，再以小孔鑽入孔道、用內視鏡觀察並取樣檢驗灌漿的氯離子與硫酸鹽。FHWA 2013 年的指引提醒，侵入式檢測本身會製造腐蝕通道，取樣數量應盡量少並確實修復。~The grout condition of completed or existing bridges can only be judged indirectly: ground-penetrating radar first locates internal tendons, impact-echo uses the frequency of stress waves reflected in the concrete to judge whether a duct contains voids, ultrasonic tomography builds section images, and radiography sees inside ducts directly but is limited by safety and thickness. Where non-destructive results are doubtful, a small hole is drilled into the duct, inspected with a borescope and the grout sampled for chloride and sulfate. FHWA's 2013 guidance warns that invasive testing itself creates corrosion paths, so the number of samples should be minimised and every hole properly repaired.
units.model: 敲擊回音厚度頻率 f = β·C_p/(2T)。腹板厚 T = 0.30 m、C_p = 4,000 m/s、β = 0.96：f = 0.96×4,000/0.60 = 6,400 Hz；若孔道深 0.15 m 處有空洞，反射面變為 0.15 m，頻率峰值移到 0.96×4,000/0.30 = 12,800 Hz。數值為教學假設。~Impact-echo thickness frequency f = β·C_p/(2T). For a 0.30 m web with C_p = 4,000 m/s and β = 0.96, f = 0.96×4,000/0.60 = 6,400 Hz; a void at a duct 0.15 m deep moves the reflecting surface to 0.15 m and the peak to 0.96×4,000/0.30 = 12,800 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 先以透地雷達標出鋼腱位置，再沿鋼腱以固定間距做敲擊回音或超音波掃描，把疑似空洞標在圖上；選取代表性位置鑽孔以內視鏡確認，並以已知良好與已知空洞的位置校正判讀門檻，所有鑽孔事後以相容材料密封。~Locate tendons first with ground-penetrating radar, then scan along them at fixed spacing by impact-echo or ultrasonics and map suspected voids; drill representative locations for borescope confirmation, calibrate interpretation thresholds against known-good and known-void spots, and seal every hole afterwards with compatible material.
units.failure: 只依單一非破壞方法的結果就判定「無空洞」，忽略鋼絞線束與鋼筋造成的訊號干擾；或大量鑽孔取樣後未確實封孔，反而為水與氯離子打開新通道，加速原本完好鋼腱的腐蝕。~Declaring no voids from a single non-destructive method ignores interference from strand bundles and reinforcement; drilling many sample holes without proper sealing opens new paths for water and chloride, accelerating corrosion of tendons that were sound.
units.misconception: 非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。~Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty.
units.practice: 檢測計畫要說明採用的方法組合、掃描間距、判讀門檻與校正方式，並以風險高低決定鑽孔位置與數量；鑽孔、取樣與封孔程序由設計者核准，結果與鋼腱編號一同存檔。~The inspection plan states the combination of methods, scan spacing, interpretation thresholds and calibration, choosing drilling locations and numbers by risk; drilling, sampling and sealing procedures are approved by the designer, and results are archived against tendon numbers.

units.anchor: 蝕坑深度與鋼絲斷面~Pit depth and wire section
units.title: 缺陷灌漿中的長期劣化~Long-term deterioration in defective grout
units.mechanism: 灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕通常是慢性的：空洞中的潮濕空氣、泌水留下的水分、離析後柔軟且鹼性不足的灌漿，以及氯離子或硫酸鹽，都會讓鋼絞線局部去鈍化並形成蝕坑。蝕坑比均勻腐蝕危險，因為鋼絲在蝕坑處應力集中、斷面驟減，在仍有高預力的情況下可能突然斷裂。外部來源同樣重要：倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋在 2011 年因除冰鹽造成鋼腱腐蝕而緊急處理，後來以外置預力補強，2015 年完成修復。~Corrosion from grout defects is usually chronic: damp air in voids, water left by bleed, segregated grout that is soft and less alkaline, and chlorides or sulfates depassivate strands locally and form pits. Pitting is more dangerous than uniform corrosion, because stress concentrates and the section drops sharply at the pit while the wire still carries high prestress, so it can snap suddenly. External sources matter too: London's Hammersmith Flyover required emergency action in 2011 when de-icing salts corroded its tendons, and was later strengthened with external post-tensioning, with repairs completed in 2015.
units.model: 腐蝕電流 1 μA/cm² 約相當於 11.6 μm/年。直徑 5 mm 鋼絲（半徑 2.5 mm）均勻腐蝕 20 年，半徑損失 0.23 mm，剩餘面積 (2.268/2.5)² ≈ 82%；若蝕坑係數 5，局部蝕坑深度約 1.16 mm，接近半徑的一半。數值為教學假設。~A corrosion current of 1 μA/cm² corresponds to about 11.6 μm per year. A 5 mm wire (2.5 mm radius) corroding uniformly for 20 years loses 0.23 mm of radius, leaving (2.268/2.5)² ≈ 82% of its area; with a pitting factor of 5, the local pit is about 1.16 mm deep, nearly half the radius. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 取出的灌漿樣本檢驗酸溶性氯離子（以水泥重量 0.08% 為門檻）、硫酸鹽與含水狀態，觀察灌漿是否柔軟、分層或變色；暴露的鋼絞線記錄蝕坑深度與斷絲數；必要時以磁漏或其他方法評估鋼腱內部斷絲，並以結構分析檢查剩餘預力的安全性。~Test extracted grout for acid-soluble chloride against the 0.08% by cement weight threshold, for sulfate and for moisture, and look for soft, layered or discoloured grout; record pit depths and broken wires on exposed strands; where needed assess internal wire breaks by magnetic flux leakage or other methods, and check the safety of the remaining prestress by analysis.
units.failure: FHWA 調查指出，美國有 10 個州回報過與灌漿缺陷或過量氯離子有關的鋼腱問題，部分是 2001 年後採用預拌灌漿的新橋；若只把問題視為舊橋專屬，新橋的離析或高硫酸鹽灌漿就會被忽略，直到斷絲才被發現。~FHWA reported that 10 states had tendon problems linked to grout deficiencies or excess chloride, some on newer bridges built with pre-bagged grouts after 2001; treating the problem as confined to old bridges lets segregated or high-sulfate grout in new bridges go unnoticed until wires break.
units.misconception: 使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。~New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects.
units.practice: 管理單位應依建造年代、材料與施工紀錄建立後拉橋梁清單，優先檢查錨頭、節塊接縫與高點；發現腐蝕時由結構工程師評估剩餘預力並決定監測、補灌、外置預力補強或鋼腱更換。~Owners should inventory post-tensioned bridges by age, materials and construction records, prioritising anchorages, segment joints and crests; where corrosion is found, a structural engineer assesses remaining prestress and decides on monitoring, regrouting, external post-tensioning or tendon replacement.

units.anchor: 灌漿量對帳與風險分數~Grout reconciliation and risk score
units.title: 灌漿紀錄、風險分級與工程交接~Grouting records, risk ranking and engineering handover
units.mechanism: 灌漿缺陷無法在完工後直接看到，因此施工紀錄是日後判斷風險的主要依據：每條鋼腱的材料批號、試驗結果、灌注量、壓力歷程與排氣順序都要保存。FHWA 2013 年的指引把風險定義為缺陷機率指標乘以破壞後果指標，各以 1 到 5 分評估，沒有紀錄的工程被直接給予最高的機率分數。英國在 1985 年 Ynys-y-Gwas 崩塌後，1992 年暫停新建內部灌漿後拉橋並進行五年檢查，1996 年才解除，說明紀錄、檢查與可更換設計對業主決策的重要性。~Grout defects cannot be seen after completion, so construction records are the main basis for later risk judgements: each tendon's material lots, test results, injected volume, pressure history and venting sequence must be kept. FHWA's 2013 guidance defines risk as a probability-of-defect indicator times a consequence-of-failure indicator, each scored 1 to 5, and projects with no records are given the highest probability score outright. After the Ynys-y-Gwas collapse of 1985, Britain halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme and lifted the moratorium only in 1996, showing how records, inspection and replaceable design shape owners' decisions.
units.model: 灌漿量對帳：理論淨灌漿 0.52 m³，扣除出口廢棄量後實際灌入 0.49 m³，短少 0.03 m³ = 30 L，相當於 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m 孔道的淨體積，應列為疑似空洞追查。風險分數 = 機率 × 後果：無紀錄 5 × 主要幹線 4 = 20（滿分 25），優先檢查。數值為教學假設。~Grout reconciliation: the theoretical net volume is 0.52 m³ and 0.49 m³ went in after outlet waste, a shortfall of 0.03 m³ = 30 L, the net volume of about 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m of duct, to be followed up as a suspected void. Risk score = probability × consequence: no records 5 × major route 4 = 20 out of 25, a priority for inspection. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前逐條核對灌漿紀錄的完整性（材料批號、試驗、壓力、排氣、灌注量與理論量對帳、空洞檢查與補灌），缺漏者補做檢測；把風險評分方法與結果寫入維護計畫，並訂定錨頭與高點的定期檢查週期。~Before handover check every tendon's grouting record for completeness (lots, tests, pressures, venting, injected versus theoretical volume, void checks and regrouting), testing where records are missing; write the risk-scoring method and results into the maintenance plan with set inspection intervals for anchorages and crests.
units.failure: 灌漿紀錄只寫「完成」而沒有灌注量與壓力資料，多年後發現某條鋼腱斷絲時，無法判斷是個案還是系統性問題，只能大範圍鑽孔檢查，既昂貴又增加新的腐蝕通道。~Records that say only completed, with no volumes or pressures, mean that when a tendon is later found with broken wires no one can tell whether it is isolated or systemic, forcing widespread drilling that is costly and opens new corrosion paths.
units.misconception: 灌漿完成後紀錄就沒有用處，不需要長期保存。~Once grouting is done the records are useless and need not be kept.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含鋼腱與排氣口配置竣工圖、每條鋼腱的灌漿紀錄與對帳、材料與試驗報告、空洞檢查與補灌紀錄、錨頭防護細部、風險評分與檢查週期；新設計優先考慮可檢查、可更換的鋼腱配置，並由業主指定的工程師核定。~Handover includes as-built tendon and vent layouts, each tendon's grouting record and reconciliation, material and test reports, void-check and regrout records, anchorage-protection details, risk scores and inspection intervals; new designs favour inspectable, replaceable tendon layouts, approved by the owner's designated engineer.

example: 設計練習：一條 100 m 長、19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線的連續梁鋼腱（A_ps = 2,660 mm²，有效應力 1,100 MPa，P_e ≈ 2.93 MN），孔道內徑 100 mm，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95，理論淨灌漿量 5,194 mm²×100 m ≈ 0.52 m³。以 30 L/min 灌注，推進速度約 5.8 m/min、需時約 17 分鐘；墩頂高點高出灌漿口 3 m，靜水壓約 56 kPa。灌漿 w/c = 0.40、水泥比重 3.15，理論密度約 1.95 kg/L，若出口量得 1.89 kg/L，代表 w/c 約 0.45、可能加水，應退料。拌合水氯離子 500 mg/L 帶入 0.02%，材料 0.05%，合計 0.07% 低於 0.08%。完工對帳實際灌入 0.49 m³，短少 30 L，約 5.8 m 孔道體積；以波以耳法量測高點空洞約 5.7 L 並真空補灌。若此鋼腱因空洞腐蝕斷 3 股，預力損失約 16%（0.46 MN）。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁或產品的設計。~Design exercise: a 100 m continuous-girder tendon of 19 strands of 15.2 mm (A_ps = 2,660 mm², effective stress 1,100 MPa, P_e ≈ 2.93 MN) sits in a 100 mm duct with an area ratio of 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95 and a theoretical net grout volume of 5,194 mm²×100 m ≈ 0.52 m³. Pumping at 30 L/min advances about 5.8 m/min and takes about 17 minutes; the pier crest is 3 m above the inlet, a static head of about 56 kPa. With w/c = 0.40 and cement specific gravity 3.15 the theoretical density is about 1.95 kg/L; an outlet reading of 1.89 kg/L implies w/c of about 0.45, probably added water, so the batch is rejected. Mixing water at 500 mg/L chloride adds 0.02% and the material 0.05%, 0.07% in total, below 0.08%. Reconciliation shows 0.49 m³ injected, a 30 L shortfall equal to about 5.8 m of duct; Boyle's-law measurement finds a crest void of about 5.7 L, which is vacuum regrouted. If the tendon later lost 3 strands to corrosion in a void, the force loss would be about 16% (0.46 MN). Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge or product.
history: Eugène Freyssinet 發展的後拉預力技術在二十世紀中葉廣泛用於橋梁，孔道灌漿被視為鋼腱的主要防蝕層。1985 年威爾斯 1953 年建成的 Ynys-y-Gwas 預鑄節塊橋因接縫處鋼腱腐蝕突然崩塌，其後英國多座橋發現鋼腱腐蝕，英國公路局在 1992 年暫停新建內部灌漿後拉橋並展開五年檢查，1996 年解除。美國自 1999 年起陸續發現灌漿空洞、泌水與錨頭腐蝕問題，2000 年夏洛特賽車場人行橋因灌漿添加未核准化學品而斷落；業界轉向預拌觸變性灌漿、PTI M55.1 灌漿規範與專業認證，FHWA 於 2013 年發布鋼腱安裝與灌漿手冊及缺陷灌漿取樣與修復指引。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或施工文件，也不構成現場作業許可。~Post-tensioning, developed by Eugène Freyssinet, spread widely in bridges in the mid-twentieth century, with duct grout regarded as the tendons' main corrosion barrier. In 1985 the Ynys-y-Gwas precast segmental bridge in Wales, built in 1953, collapsed suddenly from tendon corrosion at its joints; tendon corrosion was then found in several British bridges, and the Highways Agency halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme, lifting the moratorium in 1996. In the United States, grout voids, bleed water and anchorage corrosion came to light from 1999, and in 2000 the Charlotte Motor Speedway footbridge fell because an unapproved chemical had been added to its grout; industry moved to pre-bagged thixotropic grouts, the PTI M55.1 grouting specification and specialist certification, and in 2013 FHWA published its tendon installation and grouting manual and guidelines for sampling and restoring defective grout. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or construction documents, and is not an authorisation for field work.

英國公路局 1992 年暫停新建內部灌漿後拉橋並進行五年檢查，1996 年解除~Britain's Highways Agency halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme and lifted the halt in 1996

倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋 2011 年因除冰鹽造成鋼腱腐蝕，2015 年完成外置預力修復~London's Hammersmith Flyover suffered tendon corrosion from de-icing salt in 2011, with external post-tensioning repairs completed in 2015

FHWA 2013 年指引以 1 到 5 分的機率與後果指標相乘評估缺陷灌漿風險~FHWA's 2013 guidance ranks defective-grout risk by multiplying probability and consequence indicators each scored 1 to 5
